articles.summary: Dallas, Texas, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Outdoor Holding Company (Nasdaq: POWW, POWWP) (“OHC,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “Company”), the owner of GunBroker.com , the largest online marketplace dedicated to firearms, hunting, shooting and related products, today announced that the holders of record of the Company’s 8.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock (the “Series A Preferred Stock”) as of the close of business on December 1, 2026 will receive a cash dividend equal to $0.546875 per share of Series A Preferred Stock. The cash dividend will be paid on December 15, 2026. About Outdoor Holding Company Outdoor Holding Company is the publicly traded parent and operator of GunBroker.com, the largest online marketplace dedicated to firearms, hunting, shooting and related products.
